title: In-progress drag survives a settings-panel open/close — release after close commits the draw at the new cursor position
evidence: exec.odin:47-55 Toggle_Settings: 'inp.panel_open = !inp.panel_open / if inp.panel_open { inp.panel_row = 0 / inp.press_swallowed = true }' — inp.drag is never cleared. mouse.odin:336-342: 'if inp.panel_open { // suppressed — the panel owns the surface } else if drag_eff && placing_eff < 0 { ... append(out, Intent(Drag_Release{pos = release_pos})) }'
detail: Carry: still present since round 6. S is collectible mid-drag (sel_pipe<0 during a fresh draw); the modal suppresses releases while open but preserves drag.active — after close, Drag_Release commits the stale gesture at the new cursor position.
recommended_fix: Cancel the drag (clear inp.drag / emit Cancel_Drag) when Toggle_Settings opens the panel, or clear drag state on close.

title: S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected — panel footer copy 'S / tap chip to close' false in that state
evidence: mouse.odin:99-105: 'case .S: ... if inp.sel_pipe < 0 { if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = .S; keys_n += 1 } }' — the S collection gate is sel_pipe, not panel_open. settings_panel.odin:121: 'draw_text_c(v, "S / tap chip to close", ...)'
detail: Carry: still present since round 2. The panel can be opened with a pipe selected (chip tap keeps sel_pipe); the advertised keyboard close is then dead. Chip tap and pad B still close.
recommended_fix: Collect S whenever inp.panel_open (or unconditionally — the executor's Set_Lane gate keeps the paths exclusive), or fix the footer copy.

title: Two Touch_Press events in one frame each call on_ui_press — two chip taps toggle the panel open then closed
evidence: touch.odin:31-44: 'if inp.panel_open { for ev in events { v, ok := ev.(Touch_Press) ... if inp.on_ui_press != nil { if inp.on_ui_press(inp.user, inp, v.pos) { inp.press_swallowed = true } } } return }' — every Touch_Press in the frame hits settings_press with no one-toggle-per-frame guard.
detail: Carry: still present since round 6. Multi-touch two-finger same-frame chip taps net to closed; a row-press + chip-press same frame also applies an adjust then closes.
recommended_fix: Break after the first swallowed panel press, or latch a per-frame 'panel press consumed' flag.

title: Phase-1 key buffer [10]Key vs 12 collectible keys — same-frame super-chord silently drops the last-collected key
evidence: mouse.odin:66: 'keys: [10]Key' vs collection sites for P, Space, H, A, M, S, Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter, Esc (12 distinct), each guarded 'if keys_n < len(keys)'.
detail: Carry: still present since round 2 (buffer was [5], widened to [10] for 7.3; the 7.3 additions made 12 collectible). The drop is order-dependent (event order), so a keypress is silently lost.
recommended_fix: Size the buffer to the collectible key count (12) or use a [dynamic].

title: Left/Right/Enter collected while the panel is closed but never mapped — dead keys in the phase-1 loop
evidence: mouse.odin:106-110: 'case .Up, .Down, .Left, .Right, .Enter: ... keys[keys_n] = e.key' — collected unconditionally; the closed-panel switch (mouse.odin:168+) maps only .P/.Space/.H/.A/.M/.S/.Up/.Down/.Esc — .Left/.Right/.Enter fall through #partial case: unmapped.
detail: Carry: still present since round 5. Closed-panel Left/Right/Enter occupy key-buffer slots and map to no intent; Up/Down emit Settings_Navigate which the executor no-ops when closed.
recommended_fix: Gate Left/Right/Enter collection on inp.panel_open, or map them explicitly.
